name: – Stéphanie Yon-Courtin – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on competition policy – annual report 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on how EU competition rules should work. It asks for stronger, independent enforcement, more staff and resources for the Commission's competition department, and a possible new EU competition body. It wants strict application of the digital markets rules to big online platforms, including in cloud and artificial intelligence. It also calls for updated merger guidelines, simpler state aid procedures, and a formal role for Parliament in overseeing competition policy. This is an opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to act on enforcement, digital rules, mergers and state aid.
- **Who it affects:** Large tech platforms, companies merging, firms receiving state aid, and small businesses.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council and the Commission, which decide whether to follow it.
